narr: Severe weather was the main concern on this day as an upper level low lifted across the region. Thunderstorms did occur late in the day and while most of them stayed below severe limits, a few storms produced high winds and large hail. Additionally, stronger winds were observed across parts of the higher terrain.
ev: Numerous reports of flooding in Trinidad with several county roads washed out or partially washed out. Purgatoire river went out of its banks along Highway 12 west of Trinidad.
